I opened PR #1 as an interactive card: [madsbolaris/trailvault-capture-test#1](https://github.com/madsbolaris/trailvault-capture-test/pull/1), showing the overview with live GitHub data.

The connected app has no `open_pr_workbench` tool. Its tool for this is `open_pull_request`, and that's what I used. It only accepts GitHub PR URLs, so I gave it the GitHub address of the same PR instead of the `127.0.0.1:5199` link you pasted. The card opens on the same overview page.
